text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: p99 latency > 10s for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (SLO: 3s) — paging oncall now. severity=P2
Samir (oncall): ack - looking
Samir (oncall): quick metrics dump: p50=120ms, p95=1.8s, p99=12.4s. streaming stalls count up 45% over baseline
Elaine: seeing same in eu-west-1 dashboards?
Samir (oncall): eu-west unaffected, spike concentrated in us-west-2. correlates with increase in long-seq decode requests.
Chen: logs show lots of KV cache evictions and "kv_prefill_miss" spikes. sending sample logs:
```
[2026-03-14T16:03:21Z] model-worker-57 WARNING KVCache evict key=conv-xyz size=128MB reason=pressure
[2026-03-14T16:03:22Z] model-worker-57 INFO prefill_miss count=312 window=60s
[2026-03-14T16:03:23Z] model-worker-58 ERROR decode_time=21.3s tail=true request_id=abc123
```
Samir (oncall): hypothesis: cache fragmentation / eviction thrash — heavy prefill vs decode imbalance when many long-context requests arrive causing KV cache churn and tail latency.
Mina: do we have heap/cpu/GPU saturations?
Samir (oncall): GPU mem usage fine per node (~70%), CPU spiking on decoder threads, and free KV slots low. it looks like KV store hitting fragmentation and GC.
Josh: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily reduce prefill (prefill=false) for streaming endpoints, 2) increase KV pool size on affected pools, 3) route long-context traffic to smaller model variant, 4) restart a subset of model-workers to defragment.
Samir (oncall): implementing mitigation 1 and 3 now. patching route rule to set prefill=false for /v1/stream and adding fallback to model-v2-small.
Samir (oncall): command run:
```
# toggle prefill via feature-flag service
curl -sS -X POST "https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"prefill_streaming","value":false,"env":"us-west-2"}'
```
Samir (oncall): and update routing:
```
redwoodctl routes update --region us-west-2 --route /v1/stream --fallback model-v2-small --reason "KV pressure mitigation"
```
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: feature flag update accepted (id=f-9876)
Chen: increasing kv_pool for pool=rw-usw2-1 from 24GB -> 32GB via infra API (rolling)
Mina: doing a rolling restart of model-worker pods with label "kv-pool=rw-usw2-1" to clear fragmentation.
Elaine: FYI, support queue: two customers reported multiple 15-30s stalls; assigning to CS, please prepare blameless note.
Samir (oncall): immediate numbers after toggles: p95 down to 900ms, p99 down to 3.2s, streaming stalls dropped 70% in 10m. still seeing some tail outliers.
Josh: good. next step: confirm no regression in throughput, and watch for cache warmup (prefill disabled might increase token cost).
Chen: infra rolling increase completed on 3/3 nodes. memory usage more balanced.
Samir (oncall): restart finished. metrics update: p95=650ms, p99=1.6s. we're back within SLO for most traffic.
Mina: leaving a note in runbook -> KV_CACHE: add emergency knob to throttle prefill rate and auto-bump pool on pressure metric.
Elaine: handoff time in 20m. Samir can you summarize page and actions for next oncall?
Samir (oncall): handoff summary:
- Incident: p99 latency spike in us-west-2 due to KV cache pressure/fragmentation
- Timeline: spike detected 16:03Z, mitigations started 16:06Z, feature-flag prefill=false + route fallback applied 16:09Z, kv_pool increase + restarts completed 16:28Z, SLO recovering by 16:33Z
- Actions taken: disabled streaming prefill, routed long-context to smaller model, increased kv_pool size, rolling restart of model-workers, monitoring for warmup/regression
- Current state: steady, p99 ~1.6s, p95 ~650ms, no new alerts for 12m, support tickets opened for 2 impacted customers
- Followups: add auto-throttle for prefill, add pre-emptive pool-scaling policy, add a canary for long-seq workloads, create postmortem if we see recurrence
Samir (oncall): @Elaine you can take the remainder. I'll remain available for 30m for questions.
Elaine: taking. thanks @Samir — will continue monitoring and start a short incident report + customer impact note.
Chen: planned follow-up: instrument KV allocator fragmentation metrics (free-chunks, largest-free-block) and add alert when largest-free-block < 20% of total.
Mina: thumbs up. also proposing a runbook entry for rolling restart acceptance criteria.
Elaine: assigning incident P2, creating ticket INC-2026-042 with CS notes and affected customers. ETA for full writeup 48h.
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked as acknowledged by Elaine.
Samir (oncall): closing active page. final ask: if anyone sees tail latency >4s in next hour, ping this thread immediately.
Elaine: noted. leaving monitoring on. :thumbsup:
